dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for the owner to show up. One cannot simply walk around without first obtaining permission.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The scenery here is pleasant. It makes one feel happy.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But I've been meaning to ask, does it never rain here?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Well, I suppose that makes sense... Worlds such as this are created as a sanctuary from wind and rain.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Pay it no heed... it's nothing.

choices.text: But we do have Inazuman hot springs here.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I've long heard tell of the hot springs in Inazuma. Did not expect that I'd see them here.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Hm? You mean the water is just artificially heated?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That's quite understandable. Even long ago, I had heard that there are no natural hot springs in Inazuma either, and that their current facilities were imported and developed by their treasury department.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The experience is not much different from that of an authentic, natural hot spring.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Of course, is there anything you would like to know?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: For example, my experiences of taste-testing the renowned springs of the world?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, unfortunately... I don't really have a taste for spring water.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Ah, then you are missing out on a great many good things in life...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Perhaps that can't be helped, some things come naturally to certain people, but not to others.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Did you know that Vishaps lose the ability to distinguish colors over the course of their evolution?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: After the window of opportunity closes, they won't ever be able to enjoy colorful paintings again.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh, I just learn things like this out of personal interest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I feel like I've heard this somewhere before...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Two things I've learned from the story of Vishaps are:

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: First, we must respect the differences between all species as well as all individuals within a species.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: And second, we mustn't squander the best years of our lives.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: How about you? Can you think of anything you should do when you are young, and not wait until you are too old and begin to regret it?

choices.text: To love others and be loved in return?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Ah, an excellent answer. It exceeds my expectations.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: If only people could actually do that, it would be wonderful... Failure to do so only floods the world with sorrow.

choices.text: To travel all around the world?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: But I think it's never too late to do that. I'm also planning to travel the world in the future, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: If you mean what I'd like to do right now, I think I would enjoy taking a nice walk.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But, if you're asking about the long-term, then I'd want all life to be able to live on in the original forms that are rightfully theirs.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: It's merely that... as of now, even existence in such a natural state must be fought for most fiercely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds kinda intense.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You're right. I'm saying that more for myself to hear than anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: If you too find yourself subject to grave injustice, yet bound by rules that are twisted and warped...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You must be willing to step up and right those wrongs.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: If you cannot break free from the eggshell, the world is naught but a prison where you are blinded and confined.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Don't be afraid of bleak desolation and poverty outside the prison, and don't fret about your stable rations being cut off once the prison is destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Outside that world... I'll always be waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll remember that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Iudex.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Hello. You may forgo the formalities.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The weather here always seems to be... pleasant.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Neuvillette.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Forget your troubles and enjoy a good night's rest.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: This bears a striking resemblance to the Fountain of Lucine. Sadly, the water here comes from a different source, so there is, of course, no way to replicate the taste.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, prior experience tells me that to most people, the visual similarity alone would be enough to prompt them to say a phrase such as: "This area has a very Fountain of Lucine flavor."

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...My cup is empty. May I avail myself of your fountain?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The office desk is, in my estimation, one of humanity's most eminently practical inventions.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: When receiving strangers, the presence of a physical boundary always proves more effective than a verbal reminder at encouraging disagreeable persons to act with relative decorum.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: And so, to me, the office desk is an item of great importance.
